notes: New route differs from other chat deterministic full-rate time-frequency residual: a conditional Transformer velocity field and explicit Gaussian paths. Earlier R20 conditional flow had different coarse DURA/MAP structure and failed; novelty is not asserted.
Only a two-record numerical feasibility diagnostic, not training or a 3pp result. R07 source 2.462 GHz differs from G10 2.45 GHz.
Frozen original F0 carries its source supervised knowledge; no TX labels, V/OE/target IQ, threshold fitting, model update or source performance assessment.
Separate F0 and flow gradient checks prevent one loss from masking a zero gradient in the other. Focused tests pass and independent P0/P1 review completed.
